blends.name: Pixl-Pal Toolbox
blends.desc:
# Be handy. Build better pixls
If you're holding a Pixl-Pal and wondering what you're gonna do with the Cha-Ching! you're earning, can I interest you in a this Pixl-Pal friendly Toolbox?
You'll be able to use it to gather materials and build special items, vehicles and more.

In addition to earning Cha-Ching! for just holding a Pixl-Pal, there'll be events that reward you additional Cha-Ching!
